name: st6-weekly-commit-module
description: ST6 Weekly Commit Module — production-ready replacement for 15-Five weekly planning with structural RCDO alignment. Monorepo: colign-backend (Spring Boot 3.3) + colign-frontend (Vite 5 MF remote) + pa-host (Vite 5 MF host shell).
//: colign-backend (Java) is not a Yarn workspace — managed by Maven.

scripts.dev: echo 'Run each app independently: yarn workspace colign-frontend dev, yarn workspace pa-host dev, (cd apps/colign-backend && mvn spring-boot:run)'
scripts.build: yarn workspace colign-frontend build && yarn workspace pa-host build
